add_block.new_heading: What does a tourist villa chef in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: A tourist villa chef handles the whole meal, from the shopping list to the last washed pan, so you get restaurant-standard food in your rental without anyone leaving the pool. It starts with a short conversation about tastes, dietary needs and the kind of trip you are having. The chef then designs a menu around that. On the day, they arrive with the groceries, cook in the villa kitchen, plate and serve each course, then clean down so the space is left as it was found. As a full catering services offer, one booking can cover a single celebration dinner or every meal across a week-long stay. Because myCHEF works as a vetted caterer, not an open marketplace, the same standards of hygiene, timing and presentation apply whether the chef is cooking for two guests or twenty.

add_block.new_heading: Tourist villa chef catering for groups, events and celebrations
new_paragraphs: Group holidays are exactly where a villa chef earns its keep. It turns a rented villa into a private restaurant nobody has to book, drive to or leave early. For families travelling together, the chef cooks around children's nap times and the grown-ups' later dinners on the same day. For friends marking a birthday, an anniversary or a reunion abroad, party catering means the host sits at the table instead of getting stuck at the stove. Corporate visitors running an offsite from a villa use the same service as a discreet form of corporate tourist villa chef catering, with working lunches and client dinners delivered on site. Whether it is a quiet dinner for a couple or catering for events with two dozen guests, the format bends to the occasion and the company you are keeping.

add_block.new_heading: What's on a tourist villa chef menu in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: The tourist villa chef menu is built to order, not picked from a fixed list, which is the whole point of hiring a chef instead of ordering delivery. Most groups mix local and international cooking across a stay. That might be an Emirati or wider Arabic spread one night, a Mediterranean seafood dinner the next, Italian pasta made from scratch, an Asian sharing menu, or a relaxed poolside grill. Breakfasts run from fresh pastries and fruit to full cooked plates, and lunches stay light for beach and pool days. Vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, nut-free and allergy-aware food is all handled as standard, so nobody at the table is an afterthought. Prefer set formats? The catering packages give tidy per-head options. Want it fully bespoke? The à la carte route lets the chef tailor every course to your group.

add_block.new_heading: In-villa logistics: kitchens, timing and dietary needs
new_paragraphs: Most Dubai holiday villas already have what a chef needs, and where they do not, myCHEF plans around it. Before the booking is confirmed the chef checks the essentials, such as the oven, hob, fridge space and serving ware, so nothing catches anyone out on the night. This home catering setup means freshly cooked food at the table instead of reheated trays, with the chef pacing courses to land when you are ready and not on a fixed clock. Serving styles stretch from plated fine dining to relaxed family-style platters and buffet spreads for bigger groups. Allergies and medical diets are logged ahead of time and cooked with separate handling. If you searched for a tourist villa chef near me from a rental you have only just walked into, this is the detail that matters most: the chef adapts to your kitchen, not the other way round.

add_block.new_heading: How much does tourist villa chef catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Tourist villa chef catering in Dubai starts from AED 700–950 per person, with the final figure set by group size, menu and how hands-on the service is. Smaller, more elaborate tasting-style dinners sit at the upper end. Larger, simpler group meals bring the per-head cost down. For guidance, myCHEF's fixed dinner packages run at AED 1,200, 2,400, 3,600, 4,500 and 5,500 depending on courses and headcount. A multi-course tasting menu is around AED 1,400, and if you want the chef cooking through a longer stay, weekly meal-prep plans are AED 1,898 and 2,698. These are honest starting points, not one flat rate, which is why the affordable choice for a big group and the luxury choice for an intimate dinner sit on the same page. See full prices and our catering price guide , or request an itemised quote for your exact tourist villa chef catering cost.

What does a tourist villa chef include?
It includes menu design, grocery sourcing, a vetted chef cooking in your villa kitchen, plating and table service, and clean-up. In short, everything from the shopping list to the last washed pan.
Can the chef cook for my whole stay, not just one dinner?
Yes. You can book a single dinner or arrange breakfasts, lunches and dinners across the entire holiday, with the chef shopping, cooking and clearing each day you want them.
Do you handle dietary needs and allergies?
Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, nut-free and allergy-aware menus are standard. Share requirements when you enquire and the menu is built around them, with separate handling for allergens.
Which areas of Dubai do you serve?
We serve all of Dubai, including Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, JBR, Emirates Hills, Dubai Hills and the Arabian Ranches villa communities. The chef travels to your rental.
How do I hire a tourist villa chef in Dubai?
Tell us your dates, guest count and villa; we send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day. Approve it and we confirm your chef — no membership and no obligation to book the whole trip.

add_block.new_heading: Why book your villa chef through myCHEF?
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. Vetting for tourist villa chef catering means identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews . That is a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about the limits, too. No system removes every risk, so we match each booking to the chef well suited to it instead of sending whoever happens to be free.

For a holiday-villa booking that default is often Ahmed Al-Rashid , whose 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique show in the way he treats each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. That range makes him a strong fit whether the group wants a relaxed poolside dinner or the most luxury tasting experience the villa can hold. We have delivered intimate villa dinners and larger celebrations across Dubai's communities.
